title: デビュー戦の後に・ここから始まる！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After successfully making her debut, Winning Ticket is so overcome with emotion that she bursts into tears.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: From here on, the real challenge for the two of us begins!
